text:
To,
The Public Information Officer,
Office of the Sub-Divisional Magistrate (Revenue),
Barasat, North 24 Parganas, West Bengal - 700124

Subject: Application under the Right to Information Act, 2005 regarding pending mutation of my land

Respected Sir/Madam,

With due respect I beg to state that I am a retired primary school teacher and a resident of Madhyamgram for the past thirty years. My late father Sri Haripada Ghosh had purchased a plot of land measuring 4 cottahs at Mouza Sajirhat, J.L. No. 51, Khatian No. 1123, Dag No. 778, by a registered sale deed in the year 1987. After the death of my father on 14th February 2019 I along with my two sisters became the legal heirs of the said property. My sisters have both executed a registered gift deed in my favour in the year 2021, a copy of which is with your office.

On 3rd March 2022 I submitted an application for mutation of the said land in my name at the BL&LRO office, Barasat-I, along with all required documents including death certificate, legal heir certificate, gift deed, and the latest tax receipt. I was given an acknowledgement slip with application number MUT/BRS-I/2022/4471. I was told by the staff that it will be done within forty five days. After that I visited the office at least fifteen times. Every time I was told that the file is with the Revenue Inspector or with the Block Land Officer or that the server is down. Once I was told that the field enquiry has been done and only the signature is pending. Another time a person in the office told me that some 'arrangement' has to be made to get the work done quickly, which I refused because I am an honest man and have taught children honesty all my life.

Because of the mutation not being done I am unable to get my name in the Record of Rights and I could not take a loan from the bank for the treatment of my wife who is suffering from kidney disease. I also could not sell a portion of the land to arrange money for the treatment. This has caused me great mental agony and financial hardship. My wife has to go for dialysis twice a week and the cost is very heavy for a pensioner like me. I have also written letters to the BL&LRO on 10/08/2022, 15/02/2023 and 20/11/2024 but I have not received any reply to any of these letters till today. I also lodged a grievance on the state grievance portal but it was closed saying the matter is under process.

Therefore I request you to kindly provide me the following information under the RTI Act, 2005:

1. Present status of my mutation application no. MUT/BRS-I/2022/4471 as per your records.
2. Certified copy of all the file notings and order sheet on the said application from 03/03/2022 till the date of this application.
3. Copy of the field enquiry report of the Revenue Inspector on the said application.
4. Names and designations of the officers with whom the file was pending between 03/03/2022 and 31/10/2025, with dates.
5. Copy of the government order prescribing the time limit for disposal of mutation applications in force during 2022-2025.

I further request you to kindly direct the concerned officials to complete my mutation immediately and take action against the staff who delayed my file.

I am enclosing Indian Postal Order No. 19G 552310 for Rs 10/- as application fee.

Yours faithfully,
Pradip Kumar Ghosh
14/2, Netaji Pally, Madhyamgram, Kolkata - 700129
Mobile: 98300xxxxx
Date: 01/11/2025
note: Long narrative over 500 words; ends with demand to direct officials to complete mutation and take action against staff (grievance). Records points themselves are fine.
